requirements.summary: Create landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and call-to-action
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays a welcoming hero section
Key features or benefits of the platform are highlighted

file_operations.description: Create landing page component with hero section using generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-learning.dim_1200x600.png, feature highlights showcasing course browsing and enrollment capabilities, and call-to-action button linking to course listing. Apply warm color theme from global styles.
Add route for LandingPage component at root path '/' and wire it into the router configuration. Ensure navigation structure includes link to landing page.

requirements.summary: Implement course listing view with title, description, and enrollment status
acceptanceCriteria: Course list displays with title and description for each course
Users can view all available courses
Enrollment status is visible for each course

file_operations.description: Create React Query hook to fetch available courses using getAvailableCourses backend method. Return course list with Model type (courseId, title, instructor). Handle loading and error states.
Create React Query hook to check enrollment status for a given courseId using isUserEnrolled backend method. Return boolean enrollment status. Require authentication.

Create course card component displaying course title, instructor, and enrollment status badge. Use generated icon at frontend/public/assets/generated/course-icon.dim_128x128.png as decorative element. Include enroll button that triggers enrollment action. Apply warm educational theme styling.

Create course listing page component that uses useCourses hook to fetch and display all available courses as CourseCard components in a grid layout. Show loading state and empty state messaging. Ensure authenticated users see enrollment status for each course.
Add route for CourseList component at '/courses' path and wire navigation link from LandingPage call-to-action to course listing page.

requirements.summary: Implement user enrollment functionality for authenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can enroll in available courses
Enrollment status is persisted in the backend
Users can view their enrolled courses

file_operations.description: Create React Query mutation hook to enroll authenticated user in a course using enroll backend method. Invalidate enrollment status and user courses queries on success. Use the authorization component to ensure user is authenticated before allowing enrollment. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create React Query hook to fetch courses for authenticated user using getCoursesForUser backend method with current principal. Return user's enrolled courses list. Require authentication using authorization component. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Integrate useEnrollment mutation hook to handle enrollment button click. Disable button when already enrolled or during enrollment action. Show appropriate button text based on enrollment status. Ensure only authenticated users can enroll.

Create enrolled courses view component using useUserCourses hook to display courses the authenticated user is enrolled in. Show empty state when no enrollments exist. Display course cards for enrolled courses. Require authentication to access this page using authorization component guards. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add route for MyCoursesPage component at '/my-courses' path and add navigation link to user's enrolled courses in the app navigation menu. Ensure route is protected and requires authentication.

requirements.summary: Create cohesive visual theme with warm colors, clean typography, and accessible layout
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses warm, educational tones consistently throughout the app
Typography is legible and appropriate for extended reading
Layout promotes focus and reduces visual clutter

file_operations.description: Define warm color palette using CSS custom properties with educational tones (warm oranges, yellows, earth tones) avoiding blue and purple. Set typography scale with legible font families suitable for learning content. Establish spacing and layout utilities that promote focus and reduce clutter.

Extend Tailwind configuration with warm educational color theme including primary warm accent colors, neutral backgrounds, and semantic colors for success/info states. Configure typography plugin with readable font sizes and line heights. Define spacing scale that supports focused layouts.

Create layout component wrapper that applies consistent warm theme styling, navigation structure, and accessible layout patterns across all pages. Include header with navigation and authentication status. Apply global warm color scheme and clean typography.
Wrap all routes with Layout component to ensure consistent theme application and navigation structure throughout the application.
